_comment: A5 · Auto-Convert at Triage · when status moves to TRIAGED with Size and Demand Type populated, convert the Demand placeholder into the appropriate work item. Size=S → single Story routed to squad. Size=M/L → Epic + 3 placeholder Stories under it.
name: A5 · Auto-Convert at Triage
description: Convert Demand to Story (S) or Epic + 3 Stories (M / L) when Triage passes

actions._note: Story is squad-level, no Epic parent for S-size

actions.comment: A5: Demand converted to Story (Size=S). New Story key in linked issues.

actions._step: Create 3 placeholder Stories under the Epic

fields.description: Placeholder Story under Epic {{newEpic.key}}. Originated from Demand {{issue.key}}.

actions.comment: A5: Demand converted to Epic + 3 Stories (Size={{issue."T-Shirt-Sizing"}}). New Epic key {{newEpic.key}}.

_steps_human_readable: 2. Conditions: issuetype = Demand Intake AND T-Shirt-Sizing not empty AND Demand Type not empty.
3. If Size=S → create one Story (no Epic), copy fields, link to original Demand.
4. If Size=M or L → create one Epic + 3 placeholder Stories under that Epic.
5. In all cases: copy Components, Class of Service, audit-comment on the original Demand.
Note: 'Demand on Existing Initiative' shortcut bypasses A5 — handled by a separate transition that goes Demand → Story directly without entering TRIAGED via this rule.
